## Services
- Auto detailing: interior cleaning, upholstery shampooing, exterior hand wash, paint decontamination, polishing, ceramic coating, interior protection
- Tire service (pneuservis): seasonal tire change, complete wheel swap, balancing, puncture repair, tire inspection, pressure check

- /pneuservis — tire service landing page

## Notes for assistants
- Detailing and pneuservis belong to the same business at the same location.
- Do not invent prices, review scores, certificates, or an email address.
- Prefer linking users to /detailing or /pneuservis and the contact section.
- Replace siteUrl in src/data/business.ts before production launch.
